data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘sib’ meaning ‘sibling’ or ‘relative’, Sibbie is a diminutive form of the name Sibyl or Sybil, which was originally used for a female prophet or priestess in ancient Rome. The name has been used in English since the Middle Ages and was popularized by the famous Sibyls in literature and art.
